lines.q: How long did the Hundred Years' War last?
lines.a: One hundred and sixteen years! From thirteen thirty-seven to fourteen fifty-three.

lines.q: What is a group of flamingos called?
What colour is a giraffe's tongue?
lines.a: Dark purple, almost black! Scientists think it helps against sunburn.

lines.q: Last one. How long did the shortest war in history last?
lines.a: About thirty-eight minutes! Britain against Zanzibar, in eighteen ninety-six. Didn't see that coming, right?
